title: Whether memory is shown to the wrong population

gates.criterion: the committed artefact loads at the registered 7,000 questions over 58 databases
the two halves partition the corpus and share no database
the two oracle admissions carry every repair with no break, and the mirror, so the counts agree with the corpus
random admission scales with coverage: the expected gain lies inside each reading's own clustered interval

verdicts.claim: each half holds at least 2500 questions, 25 databases and 150 discordant questions
the exchange rate is below the bare odds, recomputed from the corpus rather than transcribed
random admission scales with coverage: the expected gain lies inside the reading's own clustered interval at every share
admitting the repairable questions yields every repair and no break, and the mirror does the opposite
the self-knowledge gate clears on the confirmation half, over the precision bar, on an interval that excludes zero
neither relevance gate clears on the confirmation half
the confirmation gain is at most 70.00% of the discovery gain

statement: Memory repairs 6.39pp of the 2925 questions the bare model got wrong and breaks 5.82pp of the 4075 it got right: an exchange of 0.789 against a hurdle of 1.393, so it is 43% short of paying rather than close to a wash. Admitting only to the questions a self-knowledge gate selects covers 35.6% of the confirmation half at 62.4% precision and returns -0.05pp on [-0.50pp, 0.45pp]. Tightening the gate does not close the gap: across its six thresholds precision climbs from 41.8% to 62.4% while the precision the admitted set itself needs climbs from 46.5% to 63.3%, because the break rate inside the set goes from 5.50pp to 9.68pp while the repair rate stays inside 5.61pp–6.32pp. The best point any registered curve reached out of sample is 0.11pp at 14.8% coverage on [-0.19pp, 0.44pp], against a ceiling admission puts at 2.67pp — 4% of it.
notes: The hurdle is not parity. A repair can only happen on a question the bare model got wrong and a break only on one it got right, so the exchange rate that breaks even is the bare odds of being right — 4,075 / 2,925 = 1.393 out of sample. §147 compared 0.79 against 1.0 and read a near miss where the arithmetic shows a 43% shortfall.

Admission is selective classification (Chow 1957; El-Yaniv et al. 2010; Geifman & El-Yaniv 2017) applied to a paired treatment, which makes the perfect-ordering bound sharper than it is for accuracy: admitting the repairable questions first makes the gain 100pp on that sliver and +2.67pp on the corpus. The removal ceiling §147 published is the same bound read from the other side, at 3.39pp.

The self-knowledge gate is SKR (Wang et al., 2023) in lexical form: for each question, the share of its ten most similar questions in the same database that the bare model got wrong. SKR reports 2.91pp and 4.20pp over full retrieval on five benchmarks; the bar here is a 5.85pp lift over the base rate, so a much weaker signal is enough.

Nothing here is a model call. Coverage, pack size and the question text are columns in the artefact R30 stage 2 already paid for, and the outcomes the gate reads are the bare arm's, which is the history a deployment would have on the day it decided.
